newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Q4 growth forecast conservative-minister.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Q4 growth forecast conservative-minister.

text.p: The Singapore government's forecast of two percent fourth quarter growth in gross domestic product was conservative, Minister for Trade and Industry Yeo Cheow Tong was quoted on Thursday as saying.

The Straits Times newspaper reported Yeo as saying at a Wednesday night appearance that: "It is better for us to be on the conservative side than to be too over-optimistic. The outlook is still very uncertain."
The government on Tuesday had announced it expected GDP growth of around six percent for 1996, which suggested fourth quarter growth would be about two percent.
Referring to the government's latest forecast for 1997 growth of five to seven percent, Yeo said: "I think we should be able to look forward to a fairly reasonable rate of growth."
